processing.run.description: Runs a Processing algorithm by id and returns a dict of its outputs.
processing.run.parameter_notes: 'OUTPUT': 'memory:name' keeps the result in RAM; a file path writes to disk. Layer inputs accept a QgsVectorLayer object or a source string.
processing.run.notes: Returns a dict keyed by the algorithm's output names, not a layer. Read result['OUTPUT'].

QgsApplication.processingRegistry.description: Returns the processing registry, the entry point for enumerating every available algorithm.
QgsApplication.processingRegistry.parameter_notes: Static. Requires Processing.initialize() before providers are populated.
QgsApplication.processingRegistry.notes: len(registry.algorithms()) is 0 until the Processing framework is initialised.

QgsProcessingRegistry.algorithmById.description: Looks up one algorithm by its fully qualified id, e.g. 'native:buffer'.
QgsProcessingRegistry.algorithmById.parameter_notes: The id is 'provider:name'. Returns None for an unknown id rather than raising.
QgsProcessingRegistry.algorithmById.notes: Pair with shortHelpString() to read an algorithm's parameters before calling processing.run.

QgsProcessingAlgorithm.shortHelpString.description: Returns the HTML help text for an algorithm, including what each parameter means.
QgsProcessingAlgorithm.shortHelpString.parameter_notes: Call on the object returned by algorithmById.
QgsProcessingAlgorithm.shortHelpString.notes: The cheapest way to discover an unfamiliar algorithm's parameter names without leaving QGIS.

QgsVectorLayer.description: Constructs a vector layer. The 'memory' provider builds a scratch layer from a URI string.
QgsVectorLayer.signature: QgsVectorLayer(path_or_uri: str, layer_name: str, provider: str) -> QgsVectorLayer
QgsVectorLayer.parameter_notes: A memory URI looks like 'Point?crs=EPSG:4326&field=id:integer'. Geometry type comes first.
QgsVectorLayer.notes: ALWAYS check layer.isValid() - an invalid layer is returned, not raised, and every later call fails silently.

QgsVectorLayer.getFeatures.description: Iterates the layer's features, optionally filtered by a QgsFeatureRequest.
QgsVectorLayer.getFeatures.parameter_notes: Without a request it walks every feature. The iterator is single-pass.
QgsVectorLayer.getFeatures.notes: Do not call inside an open edit session without committing first, or you iterate stale state.

QgsFeatureRequest.setFilterExpression.description: Restricts a feature iteration to features matching a QGIS expression.
QgsFeatureRequest.setFilterExpression.parameter_notes: The expression uses QGIS expression syntax, not SQL. Field names are bare or "quoted".
QgsFeatureRequest.setFilterExpression.notes: Filtering in the request is far cheaper than iterating everything and testing in Python.

QgsVectorLayer.selectByExpression.description: Selects features matching a QGIS expression, replacing the current selection by default.
QgsVectorLayer.selectByExpression.signature: layer.selectByExpression(expression: str, behavior: int = SetSelection) -> None
QgsVectorLayer.selectByExpression.notes: Selection is canvas state, not a filter - getFeatures() still returns everything afterwards.

QgsSpatialIndex.nearestNeighbor.description: Returns the feature ids nearest to a point, using a bulk-loaded R-tree index.
QgsSpatialIndex.nearestNeighbor.parameter_notes: Build the index once from an iterator; querying it per point is what makes this fast.
QgsSpatialIndex.nearestNeighbor.notes: Returns feature IDs, not features. Look them up with getFeature(fid).

QgsVectorFileWriter.writeAsVectorFormatV.description: Writes a vector layer to disk in any OGR format (GPKG, SHP, GeoJSON).
QgsVectorFileWriter.writeAsVectorFormatV.parameter_notes: options.driverName selects the format; 'GPKG' is the QGIS-native default.
QgsVectorFileWriter.writeAsVectorFormatV.notes: V1/V2 are deprecated. Returns (errorCode, message, ...) - errorCode 0 (NoError) means success.

QgsGeometry.fromWkt.description: Builds a geometry from Well-Known Text.
QgsGeometry.fromWkt.parameter_notes: Static. Invalid WKT yields a NULL geometry rather than raising.
QgsGeometry.fromWkt.notes: Check .isNull() after parsing; a silent NULL propagates through every later operation.

QgsGeometry.buffer.description: Returns a buffer polygon around the geometry, approximating curves with `segments` per quadrant.
QgsGeometry.buffer.parameter_notes: distance is in the geometry's own CRS units - degrees in EPSG:4326, metres in a projected CRS.
QgsGeometry.buffer.notes: Buffering in a geographic CRS produces a distorted shape. Reproject before buffering by metres.

QgsGeometry.intersection.description: Returns the geometry shared by two geometries, empty when they do not overlap.
QgsGeometry.intersection.parameter_notes: Both geometries must already be in the same CRS - no transform is applied.
QgsGeometry.intersection.notes: Test .isEmpty() rather than comparing areas; a non-overlap returns an empty geometry, not None.

QgsGeometry.makeValid.description: Repairs an invalid geometry (self-intersections, unclosed rings) and returns a valid one.
QgsGeometry.makeValid.parameter_notes: Takes no arguments in the common form; returns a NEW geometry rather than repairing in place.
QgsGeometry.makeValid.notes: Run before any overlay operation - GEOS raises on invalid input, which surfaces as a bare TopologyException.

QgsGeometry.centroid.description: Returns the centre of mass of the geometry as a point geometry.
QgsGeometry.centroid.parameter_notes: Takes no arguments. The centroid of a concave polygon can fall outside it.
QgsGeometry.centroid.notes: Use pointOnSurface() instead when the result must lie inside the polygon.

QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem.fromEpsgId.description: Builds a CRS from a numeric EPSG code.
QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem.fromEpsgId.parameter_notes: Static, takes the bare integer (4326), not the 'EPSG:4326' string form.
QgsCoordinateReferenceSystem.fromEpsgId.notes: An unknown code returns an INVALID crs object rather than raising - check .isValid().

QgsCoordinateTransform.transform.description: Reprojects a point from the source CRS to the destination CRS.
QgsCoordinateTransform.transform.parameter_notes: The third constructor argument supplies the datum-transform context; pass QgsProject.instance().
QgsCoordinateTransform.transform.notes: Constructing the transform is the expensive part - build it once and reuse it across points.

QgsDistanceArea.measureLength.description: Measures true ellipsoidal length of a geometry rather than planar CRS-unit length.
QgsDistanceArea.measureLength.parameter_notes: setEllipsoid() must be called or the measurement falls back to planar CRS units.
QgsDistanceArea.measureLength.notes: This is how to get metres out of an EPSG:4326 layer without reprojecting it.

QgsProject.addMapLayer.description: Adds a layer to the current project so other tools and the canvas can see it.
QgsProject.addMapLayer.signature: QgsProject.instance().addMapLayer(layer: QgsMapLayer, addToLegend: bool = True) -> QgsMapLayer
QgsProject.addMapLayer.parameter_notes: addToLegend=False registers the layer without showing it in the layer tree.
QgsProject.addMapLayer.notes: A layer built in Python is invisible to every other tool until it is added to the project.

QgsExpression.evaluate.description: Evaluates a QGIS expression, optionally against a feature context.
QgsExpression.evaluate.parameter_notes: Without a context only context-free expressions work; field references need a feature scope.
QgsExpression.evaluate.notes: Check hasEvalError() - a failed evaluation returns None, which is indistinguishable from a NULL result.

QgsCategorizedSymbolRenderer.description: Renders each distinct value of one field with its own symbol.
QgsCategorizedSymbolRenderer.parameter_notes: attrName is a field name or an expression; categories pair a value with a symbol.
QgsCategorizedSymbolRenderer.notes: layer.triggerRepaint() is required after setRenderer() or the canvas keeps the old symbology.
